name: Parlavà (Spain)
description: Horizontal bicolour of white and red, charged at the centre with the millstone of the arms formed of two concentric discs counterchanged.
history: The flag was approved on 1 October 2007 and published in the Diari Oficial de la Generalitat de Catalunya no. 4989 of 17 October 2007; it is an oblong flag of 2:3, horizontal bicolour red and white, with the millstone of the arms at the centre formed of two concentric discs, red on the upper half and white on the lower.

features.role: millstone of two concentric discs counterchanged
